Between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]] during the invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which became known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Vong attacked the [[Hollastin system/Legends|Hollastin system]] within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The attack took place between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] and the Vong reached the [[Star system/Legends|system]] by traveling down the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] from a previous [[Attack on the Circumtore system|battle]] in the [[Circumtore system/Legends|Circumtore system]]. After the attack the Vong continued down the same hyperlane and [[Attack on the Tsyk system|attacked]] the [[Tsyk system/Legends|Tsyk system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Hollastin system was first shown in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book released in [[2009]] and written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. The attack is not mentioned in the text of the book but it shown on a map detailing conflicts in the galaxy between 26 ABY and 27 ABY during the Yuuzhan Vong war, which was called "collapse of [[Core Worlds/Legends|the Core]]". No information is given about the outcome of the attack although a separate map shows Hollastin was under Vong control by 27 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />
